literal_meaning: পালা (পালানো বা সরে যাওয়া) শব্দের দ্বিত্বপ্রকাশ, অস্থিরতা বোঝাতে ব্যবহৃত
figurative_meaning_en: Reduplication expressing restlessness or fidgety behavior
similar_in_english: restless as a cat on a hot tin roof
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মনটা পালাইপালাই হয়ে গেছে খবর শুনে।
example_sentences_in_english: The child is fidgeting in the chair.
His mind became restless after hearing the news.
history: Used in literature by Abanindranath Tagore to describe restless movement, as in his works depicting everyday Bengali life.
note: This idiom is a form of echo-word reduplication common in Bengali for emphasizing mannerisms.
